conditions.runtime: Both installed Building But Better and Handcrafted are present; a player uses bbb:hammer on a block implementing Handcrafted's native Hammerable interface.

change.summary: Use the existing 3D BBB hammer for both native BBB and Handcrafted hammer interactions.

modifiers.before: The BBB hammer and Handcrafted hammer trigger separate native actions.
modifiers.after: Using bbb:hammer on a Handcrafted Hammerable block calls that installed block's native onHammer action. BBB's own hammer behavior remains on its existing path.

modifiers.before: The Handcrafted hammer has a craft recipe, JEI catalog entry, quest references and a JEM trade listing.
modifiers.after: New Handcrafted-hammer crafting, creative-tab and curated JEI display, authored quest rewards and JEM trade listing are removed in favor of bbb:hammer. The old registered item remains loadable only for existing-save compatibility.

cause.owner: JEMCompat Handcrafted adapter and JEM-authored acquisition data

rationale.purpose: Give players one existing 3D construction hammer without replacing either installed mod's block implementation or deleting legacy item data.
rationale.decision_source: User requested one hammer for the Handcrafted and Building But Better actions. Codex inspected exact installed Handcrafted Hammerable bytecode and BBB hammer behavior, then selected a Forge event adapter and author-owned acquisition edits.

introduced.summary: Route Handcrafted's native hammerable action through bbb:hammer and retire new Handcrafted-hammer acquisition.

history.summary: Keep both installed mods and old save item IDs while assigning new acquisition and interactions to the existing BBB hammer.
Remove the legacy Handcrafted hammer from creative tabs and authored acquisition, while moving the furniture quest reward to the BBB hammer.

relations: Legacy handcrafted:hammer remains a registered item for old inventory compatibility
notes: The adapter is active only when both installed mods are present and does not add a runtime library.
unresolved: Player interaction with installed Handcrafted blocks remains unobserved under the project's client-launch restriction.
